Theme

Latin word

Hui!

well, well! goodness!

In this lexicon

  • well, well!

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 5.11.1: hui, totiēnsne mē litterās dedisse Rōmam, cum ad tē nūllās darem?; Ter. Ph. 663–664: Oi! hui! Nimium est.

Examples

  • hui, totiēnsne mē litterās dedisse Rōmam, cum ad tē nūllās darem?

    Well, well: have I sent letters to Rome so often without sending you any?Cic. Att. 5.11.1
